messages:
ashley: team, QuickCare POC keeps failing when we ask the model to call a tool and return structured JSON. The response is getting truncated mid-JSON and our parser errors. Demo in 90 minutes.

pete: paste raw response and request (redact PHI)

ashley: raw response (redacted):
```
{"call_result":{"summary":"Patient stable","tags":["follow-up","telehealth"],"notes":"Reviewed meds: none","evidence":[{"id":"e1","text":"BP 120/80"}, {"id":"e2","text":"HR 72"}],
```
(ends here, no closing ] or } )

marco: looks like the model hit token limit or streaming disconnected. Are you using function_call with streaming? Any stop tokens?

ashley: function_call: "auto", streaming off, json_mode:"strict". request:
```json
{"model":"redwood-clinical-llm","json_mode":"strict","function_call":"auto","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"call summarize_tool with note"}],"max_tokens":256}
```

pete: two options to unblock: 1) increase max_tokens / allow streaming so we can get the full JSON, 2) switch to json_mode:"relaxed" and use a tolerant post-extract that attempts to close common trailing structures (e.g., add missing brackets) — risky but okay for demo. Also consider forcing the model to use a schema vending function (i.e., have the tool itself return a JSON string) to avoid mid-generation truncation.

marco: for long term we should: - prefer streaming for large outputs, - add a resumable fetch: if truncation detected, re-request with prompt prefixing the partial JSON and ask for completion only, - instrument finish_reason to detect early stop due to length and surface in Console.

ops-bot: note: increasing max_tokens for a tenant may impact cost; flagged billing for approval.

security-bot: reminder: do not include PHI in logs or chat, redact patient identifiers.

ashley: customer-facing note draft: "Temporary mitigation: increase max_tokens or enable streaming to avoid mid-JSON truncation, or set json_mode=\"relaxed\" and run a tolerant post-parse that attempts to salvage the first JSON object. Permanent: we'll add truncated-output instrumentation and a resume-on-truncate helper in the next minor release (ETA: 48h)."

pete: i'll open a quick fix PR: 1) console will detect unclosed JSON and surface a one-click 'attempt to complete' that resubmits the partial text to the model; 2) add telemetry counter for truncated-JSON occurrences. canary target 1801238000.

ashley: thanks everyone, i'll send the temporary note and ask them to enable streaming for the demo.

ops-bot: canary scheduled 1801238000, will report back here.
